fact: On 19 August 2025 the Personal Data Protection Commission, in Complaint No. PDPC/CMP/002/2025, found the respondent (an Instagram business-page owner, not named in this text) liable for unlawfully posting a newborn's photo, ordering TZS 20 million damages, a TZS 5 million fine payable to the Commission and deletion within 14 days.
title: Instagram Photo Triggers Payment of Fine
